caption: The drawing depicts a single object placed centrally on a neutral, off-white background. The object consists of a metallic oil lamp with a cylindrical base mounted on a shallow, roughly circular tray. The lamp has a distinctive, slightly bulbous upper section that tapers to a small opening at the top, where a short, brownish wick protrudes. A small tubular spout extends from the upper chamber of the lamp. The tray is uneven and has patches of rust or discoloration, primarily brown and reddish tones, suggesting age or oxidation. Attached to the tray's right side is an upturned, semi-circular metal handle. The overall color palette features grays, silvers, and browns, indicating the metallic nature and tarnished surface of the objects.
title: Colonial Lamp
